hazards.description: Residential steps and trash receptacles narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians (especially children) and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk and Obstructions
hazards.description: The effective walking width is significantly reduced by building steps and a chair, which could force pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: High-density parallel parking creates a visual barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians who might step into the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags block the effective width of the right-hand sidewalk.

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: Motorcycles parked on or very close to the narrow sidewalk reduce walking space.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: The large white SUV parked at the curb significantly blocks the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, white SUV parked along the curb

hazards.name: Substandard Sidewalk Width
hazards.description: The sidewalk is extremely narrow, likely under 4 feet, which does not allow for two people to pass comfortably or for the use of mobility devices without difficulty.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, walkway in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Tripping Hazards
hazards.description: Loose debris and small items scattered across the walking surface create a risk of falls.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left and center foreground.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions (Trash)
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are placed directly on the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, foreground.

hazards.name: Parked Motorcycles on Sidewalk
hazards.description: Motorcycles are parked on or partially blocking the sidewalk, further reducing the limited walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the narrow street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: Cracks and patches in the concrete walkway create a potential trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground walkway area

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an uncontrolled roadway without designated space or accessibility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the middle ground

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No streetlights are visible in this segment, which may reduce safety and visibility for pedestrians at night.

hazards.name: Lack of lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible in the immediate vicinity, which may compromise pedestrian safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters

interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this dense residential environment.

interventions.description: Install street lighting designed for pedestrians to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
